hero.title: Kenali Fungsi Kata, Bukan Sekadar Artinya
hero.text: Parts of speech adalah kategori yang mengelompokkan kata berdasarkan fungsinya dalam kalimat: noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, dan conjunction. Satu kata bisa berganti kelas tergantung posisinya.

cheatsheet.heading: Ide besarnya
cheatsheet.html: Jangan tanya “artinya apa?”, tapi “tugasnya apa di kalimat ini?”. Contoh dosen: morning = noun, tetapi in the morning = adverb (keterangan waktu). Kata provide punya keluarga: provide (verb) → provided → providing → provision (noun).

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 1 • Peta 7 Kelas Kata
cheatsheet.title: Tujuh Parts of Speech dari Slide
rows: I, you, he, she, it, we, they, myself, who, this
eat, paint, throw, laugh, be, have, do
beautiful, smart, tall, one hundred, which
Menjelaskan verb/adjective/kalimat: cara, tempat, waktu, frekuensi
in, on, at, to, into, towards

modes.label: Inti kalimat
modes.title: Verb wajib ada
modes.text: Kalimat bahasa Inggris minimal punya subject + verb. Kalau tidak ada kata kerja, pakai to be (is/am/are).

modes.label: Sering tertukar
modes.title: Adjective vs adverb
modes.text: She is quick (adjective, menjelaskan she) vs She runs quickly (adverb, menjelaskan runs). Banyak adverb of manner = adjective + -ly.

modes.label: Penyambung
modes.title: FANBOYS
modes.text: Coordinating conjunction dihafal dengan FANBOYS: For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So.

options.label: Concrete
options.title: Concrete noun
options.text: Bisa disentuh, dilihat, dicium, dirasa, didengar: benda fisik, makhluk, sensasi.

options.label: Abstract
options.title: Abstract noun
options.text: Ide, kualitas, atau keadaan yang tidak berwujud.

options.label: Common vs Proper
options.title: Common vs proper noun
options.text: Bedanya di huruf kapital. Common = nama umum (city, country). Proper = nama khusus, selalu kapital.

options.label: Personal
options.title: Personal pronoun
options.code: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
options.text: Kata ganti orang sebagai subjek. Contoh: They read a book in the library.

options.label: Reflexive
options.title: Reflexive pronoun
options.code: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves
options.text: Pelaku dan sasaran orang yang sama: I taught myself English.

options.label: Interrogative
options.title: Interrogative pronoun
options.code: who, what, which, whose (+ where, when, why, how)
options.text: Untuk bertanya: Who is he? When is your birthday?
options.note: ➕ Secara tata bahasa ketat, where/when/why/how termasuk interrogative adverb; slide memasukkannya karena sama-sama kata tanya.

options.label: Demonstrative
options.title: Demonstrative pronoun
options.text: Menunjuk: this/these dekat, that/those jauh. This + verb tunggal, these + verb jamak.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 4 • Tiga Jenis Verb
cheatsheet.title: Transitive, Intransitive, Auxiliary
rows: She ate an apple. They threw the ball.
The baby is sleeping. They laughed.
They are trying… / I don't know. / Have you eaten?

modes.label: Uji cepat
modes.title: Tanya “apa?”
modes.text: Setelah verb tanyakan what? Kalau ada jawabannya (ate what? → an apple), verb itu transitive.

modes.label: Contoh dosen
modes.title: provide
modes.text: Mother provides her children with the best education = Mother provides the best education for her children. Provide someone with something / provide something for someone.

modes.label: Bentuk be
modes.title: be lengkap
modes.text: is, am, are, was, were, be, been, being. have: have, has, had. do: do, does, did.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 5 • Preposition & Conjunction
cheatsheet.title: Kata Depan dan Kata Hubung
rows: in, on, at, by, under, above, between, among
at London, in the library, under the table
go to school, walk into the room

modes.label: Jebakan dosen
modes.title: at London
modes.text: Di slide: at = preposition, London = noun, at London = keterangan tempat. ➕ Untuk kota, penutur asli lebih sering pakai in London (tinggal di dalam kota); at dipakai untuk titik/lokasi spesifik (at the station).

modes.label: Berpasangan
modes.title: Correlative
modes.text: Kata kerja mengikuti subjek terdekat: Neither my friends nor my brother is here.

cheatsheet.heading: Tips belajar dari dosen
cheatsheet.html: Pakai kamus: Cambridge, Oxford, Merriam-Webster (gaya Amerika), Kamusku. Grammar: buku Betty Azar. Listening dari BBC Learning English / TED Talks: (1) dengar tanpa subtitle (biasakan aksen), (2) dengar dengan subtitle (pahami isi), (3) transcribing: tulis yang terdengar, lengkapi berkali-kali, lalu cocokkan dengan subtitle.

cells: I like tea, but my sister likes coffee.

rows.ok: ✓ Possessive (his) termasuk pronoun di slide dosen.

cells: I wake up early because I work at seven.

simulator.label: Permainan Interaktif 2 • Satu Kata, Banyak Kelas
simulator.title: Kata yang Sama, Fungsi Berbeda

rows.ok: ✓ fast tidak ditambah -ly: bentuk adverb-nya tetap fast.

cells: I provide meals in the living room.

simulator.label: Latihan 4 • Analisis Kalimat (gaya dosen)
simulator.title: Beri Label S, V, O, Adv

items.answer: S: Andi • V: is driving • O: his car
items.reason: his = pronoun (possessive) yang menempel pada objek car.

items.prompt: They read a book in the library.
items.answer: S: They • V: read • O: a book • Adv: in the library
items.reason: in the library = keterangan tempat (preposition + noun).

items.answer: When = kata tanya • is = verb (be) • your birthday = subjek
items.reason: Dalam pertanyaan dengan be, be maju ke depan subjek.

items.prompt: Mother provides her children with the best education.
items.answer: S: Mother • V: provides • O: her children • with the best education

items.prompt: They are trying to finish their programming projects.
items.answer: S: They • Aux: are • V: trying • O: to finish…
items.reason: are = auxiliary verb yang membentuk present continuous.
Contoh dosen: saya makan = I eat, saya sedang makan = I am eating (auxiliary be + -ing).

flashcards.a: Kategori grammatical untuk mengelompokkan kata berdasarkan fungsinya dalam kalimat.

flashcards.q: Sebutkan 7 parts of speech di slide.
flashcards.a: Noun, pronoun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, conjunction. (➕ Kelas ke-8 yang sering disebut: interjection, mis. Wow! Oh!)
Concrete bisa diindra (book, cat). Abstract berupa ide/keadaan (love, freedom, disappointment).

flashcards.q: Common vs proper noun dibedakan oleh…
flashcards.a: Huruf kapital. Proper noun (London, Indonesia) selalu diawali kapital.
Bentuk tunggal yang berarti kelompok: team, family, class.
This/these = dekat; that/those = jauh. This/that tunggal, these/those jamak.
Verb yang butuh objek langsung: She ate an apple.
Adjective diikuti noun (this book). Pronoun berdiri sendiri (This is mine).
morning = noun; in the morning = adverb (keterangan waktu).
in 1990 / in May / in the morning; on Sunday / on 5 May; at 7 o'clock / at night.
For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So (coordinating conjunctions).

quiz.q: Parts of speech adalah…
opts: Kategori kata berdasarkan fungsinya dalam kalimat
quiz.exp: Definisi dari slide: kategori grammatical berdasarkan fungsi kata.

quiz.q: Kata freedom termasuk…
quiz.exp: Freedom adalah ide/keadaan, tidak bisa disentuh.

quiz.q: Yang termasuk proper noun adalah…
Team, family, dan class adalah contoh…
Reflexive pronoun yang benar untuk we adalah…
She ate an apple. Kata kerja ate termasuk…
Kalimat dengan intransitive verb adalah…
They are trying to finish their projects. Kata are berfungsi sebagai…
He is a tall man. Kata tall adalah…
Which book do you want? Kata which adalah…
She sings beautifully. Kata beautifully termasuk…
Adverb of frequency adalah…
quiz.exp: here = place, quickly = manner, yesterday = time.

quiz.q: in the morning dalam kalimat berfungsi sebagai…
quiz.exp: Contoh dosen: morning = noun, in the morning = adverb.

quiz.q: Preposition yang tepat: I was born ___ 2005.
Preposition yang tepat: The class starts ___ Monday.
To, into, towards, along adalah preposition of…
FANBOYS adalah singkatan…
quiz.exp: For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So.

quiz.q: I stayed at home because it was raining. Kata because adalah…
Pasangan correlative conjunction yang benar adalah…
Pola yang benar dengan provide adalah…
opts: Mother provide the best education to with her children.
Mother provides her children for the best education.
Mother provides with her children the best education.
Mother provides her children with the best education.
quiz.exp: provide + orang + with + sesuatu, atau provide + sesuatu + for + orang.

quiz.q: This pada This is my laptop adalah…
Terjemahan yang benar untuk “Saya sedang makan” adalah…

ringkasan:
*RANGKUMAN P1 BAHASA INGGRIS: PARTS OF SPEECH*
📌 Parts of speech = kelompok kata menurut FUNGSI di kalimat.
1️⃣ Noun: concrete, abstract, common/proper (kapital), collective.
2️⃣ Pronoun: personal (I, you), reflexive (myself), interrogative (who), demonstrative (this/those).
3️⃣ Verb: transitive (butuh objek), intransitive, auxiliary (be/have/do).
4️⃣ Adjective: descriptive, quantitative, demonstrative, interrogative.
5️⃣ Adverb: manner, place, time, frequency.
6️⃣ Preposition: time (in/on/at), place, direction (to/into).
7️⃣ Conjunction: FANBOYS, subordinating (because), correlative (either…or).
⚠️ morning = noun, in the morning = adverb.

materi.label: Bagian 1
materi.title: Mengapa Belajar Parts of Speech?
materi.html:
Di kamus, setiap kata diberi label seperti n (noun), v (verb), adj, adv. Label itu memberi tahu di mana kata boleh diletakkan. Kalau kita tahu kelas katanya, kita bisa menyusun kalimat yang benar walau kosakata masih sedikit.

Dosen menekankan bahwa kelas kata ditentukan oleh fungsi. morning adalah noun, tetapi in the morning menjadi adverb (keterangan waktu). Begitu juga keluarga kata: provide (verb) → provided → providing → provision (noun).

parts.label: Noun
parts.title: Andi = proper noun
parts.text: Nama khusus orang, maka diawali huruf kapital.

parts.label: Conjunction
parts.title: and = coordinating conjunction
parts.text: Salah satu FANBOYS. Menyambung dua noun yang setara: Andi + his friends.

parts.label: Pronoun
parts.title: his = possessive
parts.text: Menggantikan “Andi's”. Slide dosen memberi label pronoun pada his di “Andi is driving his car”. ➕ Banyak buku menyebutnya possessive adjective/determiner karena selalu diikuti noun.

parts.label: Noun
parts.title: friends = common, concrete noun
parts.text: Jamak dengan -s. Subjek menjadi jamak (Andi and his friends = they), maka verb tanpa -s: study.

parts.label: Adverb + Verb
parts.title: always (adverb of frequency) + study (verb)
parts.text: always diletakkan sebelum verb utama. study = intransitive di kalimat ini (tidak ada objek).

parts.label: Article
parts.title: the = article
parts.text: ➕ Article (a/an/the) tidak masuk 7 kelas di slide; banyak tata bahasa memasukkannya ke adjective/determiner. Dibahas lagi di P2 dan P6.

parts.label: Noun
parts.title: library = noun
parts.text: in the library secara keseluruhan berfungsi sebagai keterangan tempat (adverbial).

materi.label: Bagian 2
materi.title: Noun dan Pronoun
materi.html:
Noun menamai orang, tempat, benda, atau ide. Empat jenisnya: concrete (book, cat), abstract (love, freedom, disappointment), common vs proper (city vs London, bedanya huruf kapital), dan collective (team, family: bentuknya tunggal tapi artinya banyak).

Pronoun menggantikan noun supaya tidak diulang-ulang: Andi is driving his car, bukan Andi is driving Andi's car.

modes.label: Jebakan its
modes.title: its ≠ it's
modes.text: its = miliknya (The cat ate its food). it's = it is.

materi.label: Bagian 3
materi.title: Verb: Jantung Kalimat
materi.html:
Setiap kalimat lengkap butuh verb. Slide membaginya tiga:

  • Transitive: butuh objek. She ate an apple. Tanpa objek kalimat terasa menggantung (“She ate…” apa?).
  • Intransitive: tanpa objek. They are laughing.
  • Auxiliary: kata kerja bantu be, have, do untuk membentuk tense, kalimat negatif, dan pertanyaan. They are trying… / They were trying…

Contoh dosen dengan provide (menyediakan): I provide meals in the living room. Polanya provide somebody with something atau provide something for somebody.

materi.heading: ➕ Kata kerja yang bisa dua-duanya
materi.html: Banyak verb bisa transitive dan intransitive: I eat rice (transitive) vs I eat at seven (intransitive). Yang menentukan adalah ada/tidaknya objek di kalimat itu.

materi.label: Bagian 4
materi.title: Adjective dan Adverb
materi.html:
Adjective menjelaskan noun: descriptive (beautiful, smart), quantitative (one hundred, intense), demonstrative (this book), interrogative (which bag?). Dosen mengingatkan: this/that/these/those adalah adjective kalau diikuti noun, dan pronoun kalau berdiri sendiri.

Adverb menjelaskan verb (cara, tempat, waktu, frekuensi): happily, here, now, always. Catatan dosen: “What to do / How to do” → adverb of manner menjawab how?

options.label: Aturan umum
options.title: Tambah -ly
options.code: quick → quickly, happy → happily, careful → carefully

options.label: Tidak beraturan
options.title: Bentuk khusus
options.code: good → well, fast → fast, hard → hard, late → late
options.text: He works hard (bekerja keras). hardly artinya “hampir tidak”, maknanya beda!

options.label: Jebakan -ly
options.title: Berakhiran -ly tapi adjective
options.text: a friendly teacher. Tidak ada kata “friendlily”; pakai in a friendly way.

materi.label: Bagian 5
materi.title: Preposition dan Conjunction
materi.html:
Preposition menunjukkan hubungan waktu (lahir in 1990, on a Sunday, at your prime), tempat (in, on, at, by, under, above, between, among), dan arah (to, into, towards, along).

Conjunction adalah “jembatan” (connector/bridging): coordinating = FANBOYS; subordinating (after, although, as, because, before) menyambung anak kalimat ke induk kalimat; correlative berpasangan (not only/but also, neither/nor, either/or). Slide terakhir memberi daftar panjang kata hubung berdasarkan fungsi: comparison (similarly, in contrast), cause & effect (because, therefore, as a result), illustration (for example, such as), emphasis, addition (and, also, moreover), opinion (I think, in my view), conclusion (to sum up).
